rules_authority: Wahapedia 11th edition and its verified local Data Export; current official Warhammer material used to confirm Legends game-mode guidance

source.game_mode: Standard Warhammer 40,000 datasheet; Boarding Actions and other alternate modes are outside this profile audit
source.rules_authority_scope: Current Wahapedia /wh40k11ed/ pages and the matching verified local 11e export. No earlier-edition rules were substituted.
source.reconciliation: The current page and export identify the same Warhammer Legends book and datasheet. Composition is one Vindicator; the first two units cost 185 points each, and third-plus units cost 200.

implemented_scope.composition: One Vindicator model; model characteristics and default equipment match the current export.
implemented_scope.geometry_proxy: 60 mm circular footprint; exact source footprint is unspecified and physical clearance is not certified.
implemented_scope.siege_shield: Owner's Shooting phase while engaged and using close-quarters shooting; attacks targeting an enemy engaged with the Vindicator may ignore BS/Hit modifiers. The Demolisher Cannon may be selected without BLAST and then may target an enemy not engaged with another friendly unit. Runtime elects to ignore all applicable BS/Hit modifiers.

runtime.unsupported_configurations: No source-listed alternate model count. Exact physical footprint is unspecified by the source and uses a labelled local proxy.

verification.focused_regression_command: python tools/verify.py --godot .tools/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe --profile targeted --timeout 900 --only test_vindicator --only test_ballistus_dreadnought --only test_redemptor_dreadnought --only test_brutalis_dreadnought --only test_death_company_dreadnought --only test_gladiator_lancer --only test_gladiator_reaper_current --only test_gladiator_valiant --only test_storm_speeder_hammerstrike --only test_storm_speeder_hailstrike --only test_storm_speeder_thunderstrike --only test_baal_predator
